body:
This PR replaces the `PlaceholderSpace` infrastructure with a new `PlaceholderGrid` type and an associated `toggle_placeholder_grid` function.

Relevant kernels now use `toggle_placeholder_grid` to remove duplicate grid pointers before they are launched, and immediately reintroduce the grids when the kernel starts executing. Operator broadcast expressions no longer use placeholders on CPUs or in device-side scopes like `ThisBlock`. The finite difference operator functions no longer pass around a `space` argument, as `bc` contains all necessary spatial information. This is a prerequisite for #2634, which will enable column fusion by materializing slices of `bc` into shared memory arrays.

Two new types of functionality are enabled by these changes: lazily slicing the results of finite difference operators like `FCTZalesak` on high-resolution spaces, and applying spectral element operators to mixed-space expressions like `field .* level(field, 1)`.
